title: Structural and regulatory evolution across the genus Hordeum
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11332-7

Chromosome-scale pangenomics across diploid Hordeum species reveals extensive structural variation, hybridization, introgression, horizontal gene transfer and regulatory evolution, revealing adaptive trait diversification and providing genomic resources for barley improvement.
